invariants.rationale: The returned map is always freshly constructed as a new LinkedHashMap, never null.
partitioner is used for method calls and is never null inside the method.
dedupedRecords is used for stream processing and is required to be non-null.
All partition keys computed from dedupedRecords and partitioner are present in the result map; getPartitions would hypothetically collect all used partitions.
Every HoodieRecord<T> in the result map's values originated from dedupedRecords.
